thread:
Luis (CS): Quick heads-up — CinderTech renewal is stalled. Procurement insists on separate POs for services vs seats, wants vendor code, and is asking for net60. Enablement scheduled 2024-11-12. Risk of slipping.

Maya Chen: RevOps can do split invoices but needs both POs + tax docs. Net60 ok only with a 1% processing fee and finance approval. We need POs by 2024-11-01 to keep enablement.

Drew Park: They asked to reduce the liability cap and remove our limitation on consequential damages. Legal already said that's a non-starter. Could offer a narrow carveout for direct data-loss claims.

Samira (Legal): Correct — cannot remove limit. Proposed compromise: carveout limited to direct damages arising from gross negligence related to data handling, capped at 1x the annual contract value. Will draft language today.

Noah (Finance): Confirming net60 + 1% fee OK if POs and vendor code are in the system. Also require W-9 for US entity or VAT reg for EU. If split billing, separate billing contacts needed.

Luis (CS): Pricing ask — customer requested 12% off for year 1 if they sign a 24mo. Can we counter?

Maya Chen: Approve 8% for 24mo + prorated first invoice. Anything >8% needs manager sign-off. Also require e-sign for faster routing; wet-sign acceptable but slower.

Luis (CS): I'll propose: 8% two-year loyalty, net60 with 1% fee, split invoices, and the legal carveout. Ask them for both POs + vendor code and W-9/VAT. Request e-sign from authorized signer.

contract-bot: Draft amendment shared: https://docsend.example/CinderRenewal_v1 (expires in 7 days). Includes split-billing table, 8% 24mo discount, net60+1% fee option, and proposed legal carveout.

Samira (Legal): I'll attach the carveout text to the DocSend and note it's conditional on SOC2 attestation being attached. Do not concede consequential damages removal.

Drew Park: If POs not received by 2024-11-01, plan B: provision minimal onboarding package to enable 3 seats and deliver async enablement docs to keep momentum. Notify customer they'll need full signature to unlock remaining seats.

Luis (CS): Sending amendment now and pinging CFO. Will update here. :thumbsup:
